risks.risk: Engine displacement/variant mismatch (e.g., not actually 2.0, or different engine family such as petrol vs diesel, or different ECU/sensor layout).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine code/ID plate (often on the block or timing cover) and the full part number/label.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the worst-case mismatch risk: treat as not confirmed compatible and assume buyer may need additional parts/ECU wiring to make it fit.

risks.risk: Wrong engine type (petrol vs diesel) or wrong transmission/ancillaries included.
risks.proof: Photos of the engine label plus a shot showing the starter location, fuel system type (diesel pump/injector lines vs petrol components), and what ancillaries are included.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/uncertain fit: assume missing key ancillaries and compatibility issues.

risks.risk: Unknown condition (running status, compression, leaks, bent components).
risks.proof: Video of a cold start (or at least a test run) and photos of any visible damage/leaks; also compression test results if available.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working: assume overhaul/repairs may be needed.

risks.risk: Missing sensors/ECU/loom connectors (seller says 'Sensor Engine' but parts may be missing).
risks.proof: Inventory photos: sensors, ECU, wiring harness connectors, and a checklist of included parts with close-ups.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as missing/uncertain included sensors and electronics.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the engine code/ID plate and any stamped numbers on the block (photo 0 is not readable).
Photo of the ECU/engine control unit label (part number) and the wiring harness connectors.
Video proof of running (or compression/leak test results) plus photos of any leaks/cracks/damage.
A shot showing exactly what is included (starter, alternator, turbo if diesel, intake/exhaust manifolds, sensors/ECU).
response.reason: The photo shows an engine assembly, but the critical identifiers (engine code/part number) and condition proof are not readable/visible. Without those, compatibility for Passat/Sharan and whether it is truly a 2.0 sensor engine cannot be confirmed, so pricing would be guesswork.
